title: Tumpak Award
quote: Tumpak means precise, accurate, exactly right… her nomination used data, not feelings.
context: TeamPinoy Bayani Award — 'Speed is Our Edge.' Apr–May 2026: zero Critical/High flags across every Escalibur scan; on May 27 moved 15 tickets and closed 4 in a single shift; reproduced a complex SFTP issue herself before escalating; clean, disciplined handoffs.
